summary: Comprehensive frontend-only Playwright testing of the nFinans Premium Algo landing page. All 13 requested test cases passed. Whop loader script present, hero/header/nav/i18n/algorithm sections/pricing cards/All-In-One/footer/mobile menu all render correctly. Whop plan_ids appear in DOM with correct attributes when 'Seç' is clicked. Language toggle works and persists via localStorage 'nf_lang'.
verified_features: Hero renders 'Data is new oil.' / 'AI is new electricity.' with primary CTA (hero-cta-primary) and 3 stats (hero-stat-0..2)
Sticky header (site-header) visible with 4 nav links: algorithms, pack, about, contact
TR/EN toggle works (lang-toggle-tr / lang-toggle-en); EN switches 'Algoritmalar' -> 'Algorithms', hero lede flips to English
Language preference persists in localStorage key 'nf_lang' and survives page reload
All 5 algorithm sections render (ml-quant, right-side, liquidity-sr, sentiment-momentum, trend-cycles)
All 20 pricing-card-{algoId}-{tier} cards present with correct prices: ml-quant & right-side -> 34.99/49.99/74.99/149.99; liquidity-sr/sentiment-momentum/trend-cycles -> 9.99/14.99/24.99/49.99
Discount badges (pricing-discount-*) render %20 / %30 / %55 / %70 correctly across all 20 cards
12m card has 'En Popüler' (★) badge and lifetime shows '∞ Ömür Boyu' badge

Clicking pricing-select-btn-{algoId}-{tier} expands inline section and renders div[data-whop-checkout-plan-id] with the exact planId; button text toggles to 'Kapat / Close' and collapses on second click. Verified for: ml-quant-3m (plan_i9HJZf7FZL3AF), right-side-3m (plan_Tzh1oQY86MJwj), trend-cycles-lifetime (plan_o9NDkNeH2OnH1)
All-In-One section (all-in-one-section) renders with hype banner, title 'All In One Pack', 4 plan cards, line-through originals 62.49/99.98/333.32/833.30, current prices 49.99/79.99/149.99/249.99
aio-select-btn-3m / aio-select-btn-12m / aio-select-btn-lifetime expand and inject data-whop-checkout-plan-id with plan_55Lpwz1tC3HIt, plan_TwfhPL2saqIpf, plan_vj6sv31xW9eD9 respectively
About section renders with 'Biz Kimiz?' kicker
Footer (site-footer) shows NFİNANS legal name, MERSIS 0631208828100001, VKN 6312088281, Gölcük, full address 'YAZLIK YENİ MAH...', WhatsApp href wa.me/905415478141 and mailto:info@privyalgo.com
Mobile (390x844): mobile-menu-toggle visible, opens mobile-nav-link-* and mobile-lang-tr/en
console_observations: No app-originated JS errors. All console errors/warnings stem from the embedded third-party Whop iframe (sessionKey, accelerometer permissions policy, basistheory.com postMessage origin) and PostHog asset preload — these are explicitly out-of-scope per the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: WhopCheckout.jsx hardcodes the loading text in Turkish ('Whop checkout yükleniyor…'); consider i18n via useLang() for parity with EN mode.

Minor: PricingCard.jsx and AllInOnePack.jsx hardcode the collapse button label ('✕  Kapat / Close') instead of using t.plans / t.allInOne — works because both languages are shown, but not strictly i18n-consistent.
Suggestion: algorithms.js exports plain price strings; consider numeric values + a formatter to avoid locale issues if multi-currency is added later.
Non-blocking: index.html still has lang="en" hard-coded on <html>; could be dynamically toggled when LangContext switches for better a11y.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Implementation is complete and verified for spec. Algorithm IDs are ml-quant, right-side, liquidity-sr, sentiment-momentum, trend-cycles. Tier IDs are 3m/6m/12m/lifetime. All Whop plan_ids verified against /app/frontend/src/data/algorithms.js and rendered in DOM via data-whop-checkout-plan-id attribute when Seç buttons are clicked. The Whop iframe contents themselves do not render in headless testing (sessionKey required) but the DOM attribute exists — this is expected per the review note.
